messages:
Diana S: alert from cloud-audit: spike in KMS Decrypt on key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/secrets/keys/ai-kms-key from svc account ci-runner@infra-prod. 200+ Decrypts in 4m. Looks like a recent TF deploy by Kevin L.
Samir P: seeing same in logs. source IPs are internal but this svc account isn't normally used for decryption. raising high-sev.
Diana S: digging -> found iam binding added to key's policy with members: ['serviceAccount:ci-runner@infra-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com', 'allUsers'] — wtf.
Kevin L: oh no, which PR? I just merged infra/terraform-modules#482. I set var.public_members = [] but default was '*' because of bad interpolation. Sorry. I can revert immediately.
Jordan (oncall): containment plan: 1) remove the binding from the KMS key 2) disable the service account 3) rotate key. I'll run commands now.
Jordan (oncall): running: gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding ai-kms-key --location=global --keyring=secrets --member='allUsers' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter'
OpsBot: INC-2026-345 created: "tf-misconfig-kms-key-public-binding" assigned to eng-security. Priority P1.
Jordan (oncall): command returned 200 OK. policy binding removed.
Diana S: disabling svc account: gcloud iam service-accounts disable ci-runner@infra-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Kevin L: reverting the TF change and opening PR with a fix for default var and adding a null check. PR: infra/terraform-modules#485
Maria T: we need key rotation and re-encryption plan. who owns rewrap?
Samir P: I'll own rotation. plan: create new key ai-kms-key-v2, rewrap secrets, update workloads to use new key, roll traffic, then schedule destroy of old key after confirm.
Diana S: add immediate blocks: 1) terraform CI guard to fail on members=['allUsers'] 2) policy check requiring iam_conditions for cross-project or public grants 3) alert on KMS decrypt spike.
Kevin L: adding tests and policy. also amending release checklist: do not use '*' as default for members.
Jordan (oncall): notify customers? exposure appears internal only but Legal wants a heads up. @Legal FYI.
Legal: confirm. please send initial incident summary to legal@redwood with timeline and mitigation steps. keep diffs, PRs, and raw logs.
Diana S: post-incident actions (short): 1) CI guard for TF PRs 2) IAM audit alert thresholds tightened 3) KMS policy review and least-privilege sweep 4) training for infra team on IAM defaults.
Kevin L: apologies. will join remediation sprint at 14:00.
Diana S: closing loop: old key to be scheduled for destroy 7 days after successful rotation; monitoring rule created for any KMS Decrypt spike -> page eng-security.
Samir P: done. added monitoring: alert id kms-decrypt-spike-01 with 5m window and threshold 50 decrypts.
OpsBot: incident INC-2026-345 updated: status = contained, severity = P2, assignees = [Jordan, Samir, Diana].
Diana S: thanks all. filing postmortem doc in /docs/incidents/INC-2026-345.md
